answer: A Sybil attacker is stopped by a per-identity bond locked in escrow before an address can answer or earn. One thousand puppets means posting that stake one thousand times, pushing the attacker to a nadir of capital efficiency: each fake identity locks the same principal, and a single slash vaporizes it. Honest miners amortize one bond across many epochs, but the farm pays full cost up front and still loses, since clustered accounts never reach the onyx tier of the reputation graph and their reward decays while capital stays frozen. The inlet of agents is gated by collateral, not a captcha.
